summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a cash dividend of NOK 3.6041 per share (USD 0.39) for the fourth quarter of 2025, payable on May 27, 2026. The NOK amount was determined using the average USDNOK fixing rate from Norges Bank around the record date. This is a routine dividend declaration and payment notification, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The filing is a standard ongoing disclosure under Norwegian law and SEC Rule 13a-16.
